_planNotes.scope: SMAA Portland summer campaign. 3 angles (Coach Trust / Summer Gap / Confidence) x 3 ads (short/medium/long) = 9 creatives, one per ad. Brand = smaa (data/brand.smaa.json). Location = portland (eyebrow auto-anchors 'PORTLAND SPORT PARENTS').
_planNotes.today: Ad-copy-only pass. Media = SMAA brand-kit photos as PLACEHOLDERS (hero/founder/step1-3), distinct per asset within an angle. Real SMAA training media to be pulled from Kraken later and swapped in the editor. No reverse brief / microscripts exist for this campaign (the copy notes 'no RB').
_planNotes.copyRule: BY REFERENCE, VERBATIM. On-creative copy = each ad's Headline-on-image (role hook) + Sub-headline-on-image (role reframe), bound by copyRefs to copy-library.json ids (ad-a1.imageHeadline etc.). Offer cards bind offer to the ad's verbatim '$100 off' bodyPara. Nothing authored or paraphrased.
_planNotes.format: Mix: 2 motion (A2 meet-coach + C2 coach-lower-thirds, Coach Jeremy, founder/training photo) + 7 static (clean AA-native cluster bank, remapped to SMAA blue #017ee6). Motion templateData fully set so no AA stock defaults leak.
_planNotes.beats: short=A (hook) · medium=C/D (mechanism / coach proof) · long=D (reframe). Letters A/C/D. NO F (offer) beat today: the clean static bank has no offer-only card without a guarantee slot (cluster-32 would leak AA's guarantee). The '$100 off' / founding-member offer lives in the ad BODY copy; an on-creative offer card is the flagged next step (confirm SMAA guarantee -> unlock cluster-32, or promote an offer template). Per-angle: 3 distinct skeletons + 3 distinct media.
_planNotes.brandSync: fill-core aliases tier brand_name -> the cluster `brand` tag, so the wordmark reads SOUTHERN MAINE ATHLETE ACADEMY; palette.mjs remaps the bank red to SMAA blue. Verified.
_planNotes.guarantee: SMAA guarantee wording not yet confirmed verbatim, so NO guarantee-slot templates used (cluster-32/season-clock/stat-reveal avoided). Add once Cody confirms the exact line.
_planNotes.status: All 'pending' — awaiting approval on the review page. No render until approved.

angles.name: Coach Trust — minutes come from coach trust, not effort (ad copy Angle A)
angles.mechanism: Coaches play the kids they trust with the ball when the game is tight; trust is built in the half-second after the ball arrives (first touch + quick decision under pressure), and that is coachable.
angles.emotionalJob: Remove blame from the kid's effort and the parent's parenting; relocate the bench problem to a trainable skill.
angles.voice: Head-coach-to-parent, declarative. No emoji, no exclamation, no em dash.

angles.name: Summer Gap — a busy soccer summer is not a developmental one (ad copy Angle B)
angles.mechanism: Game volume builds game IQ, not the physical/technical separators; those need eyes on every touch and a real plan. Summer (no games to win) is when players actually separate.
angles.emotionalJob: Reframe a 'busy summer' as a 'wasted summer' without blaming the parent's effort.
angles.voice: Head-coach-to-parent, declarative. No emoji, no exclamation, no em dash.

angles.name: Confidence — confidence is downstream of competence (ad copy Angle C)
angles.mechanism: Confidence is not a pep talk; it is a byproduct of a reliable first touch. Build the skill and belief follows; a kid who can handle the ball stops hiding from it.
angles.emotionalJob: Reframe confidence from an unfixable personality trait to a fixable skill outcome; warm, situation-focused, never about the child's character.
angles.voice: Head-coach-to-parent, declarative. No emoji, no exclamation, no em dash.
